parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the internal contact switch of the slide switch, made of copper alloy for good electrical conductivity.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main electrical contact that opens or closes the circuit when the slider is moved.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly along the switch body to connect or disconnect electrical terminals.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is another internal contact switch component, also made of copper alloy, forming part of the electrical connection system.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the secondary contact point for the circuit, ensuring reliable switching between terminals.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while the slider moves to engage or disengage it.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the slide switch, made of durable ABS plastic to provide insulation and structural support.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the internal contacts and provides mechanical stability and insulation for the switch assembly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed and does not move during operation, serving as the main structural frame.
